name: ThinkingCap-Qwen3.8-27B

lineage.how_derived: fine-tune to cut thinking verbosity (method not described on the page summary read)

purpose: Cut thinking tokens while keeping accuracy on hard and agentic tasks (card, via page summary).

license.name: PolyForm Small Business 1.0.0 plus a personal-use grant (upstream Qwen parts Apache-2.0)
license.notes: Licence file names read from the repo listing; the text was not read. Page summary: commercial use needs a separate licence from BottleCap AI. Repo is gated (access request).

architecture.kind: hybrid Gated-DeltaNet plus full attention dense transformer (Qwen3.8-27B layout)
architecture.attention: full attention every 4th layer, hidden 5120, head dim 256

benchmarks.name: reasoning tokens versus base
benchmarks.variant: BF16, 11 benchmarks average; range 11 percent (Terminal-Bench 2.1) to 66 percent (MMMLU)

strengths: fewer thinking tokens means faster agent loops at the same decode speed
weaknesses: AIME 2026 loses 3.9 points; only 11 percent fewer tokens on Terminal-Bench 2.1
soft.maturity: 3.6k downloads, 205 likes; sibling ThinkingCap-Qwen3.6-27B was the source of a transfer component in Swift

tona_fit.reason: Token-efficient thinking directly raises effective agent speed on our decode-bound hardware at a 0.8-point average accuracy cost in the vendor table. Same layout as the base. Compare with Swift-Qwen3.8-27B and the stock model in our harness.

open_questions: agentic token savings in our harness
